title: syzygy-bpyt.8.9 adapter-credential probe: old-versus-new differential over declared and undeclared credentials
authority: OWNER-DIRECTION-GREENFIELD-PARITY-ANSWERS-2026-10-21.md, GP-Q7: "a credential list that fails closed when a configured adapter declares a credential the list lacks"
subject: packages/polaris-dossier/src/credential-probe.ts
packages/polaris-dossier/src/execution-rule.ts
packages/polaris-dossier/src/index.ts
method: The harness (harnessSource) runs createCredentialProbe over every fixture case, once with the fix and once with the base commit's subject files written over it (driverSource). The fixture cases cross seven list sources, three repository lists (CONFIGURED_ADAPTER_CREDENTIALS stand-ins) and seven declaration shapes, one of them the argument omitted as every CLI call site omits it; the base probe has no fourth parameter and ignores the declarations. An injected open records every read attempt. Seven more cases use the CLI's own call shape, createCredentialProbe(credentialListFromEnv(env)), with the real operating-system open over real files in a temporary directory (scrubbed to <dir>). A case is unchanged when result, last(), the number of list reads and the read attempts are all equal.

"""Drives the syzygy-bpyt.8.9 differential: the harness runs once with the fix (HEAD) and once with the base commit's subject files
written over it, then the fix is restored from HEAD. Subject files are the non-test sources this branch changes under
packages/polaris-dossier/src; test files are not subject files.
Usage: python3 drive.py <worktree> <base> <scratch> <out.json>"""
import json, os, signal, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT, BASE, SCRATCH, OUT = Path(sys.argv[1]), sys.argv[2], Path(sys.argv[3]), Path(sys.argv[4])
HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
TARGET = ROOT / 'packages/polaris-dossier/src/zz-b89-differential.test.ts'
TIMEOUT = 300


def git(*args):
    return subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(ROOT), *args], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout


SUBJECT = [f for f in git('diff', '--name-only', BASE, 'HEAD', '--', 'packages/polaris-dossier/src').split() if not f.endswith(('.test.ts', '.testkit.ts'))]


def run(side):
    out = SCRATCH / f'{side}.json'
    out.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    env = {**os.environ, 'B89_OUT': str(out), 'CI': '1'}
    proc = subprocess.Popen(['npx', 'vitest', 'run', '--project', '@syzygy/polaris-dossier', str(TARGET.relative_to(ROOT))], cwd=ROOT, env=env,
                            stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True)
    try:
        log, _ = proc.communicate(timeout=TIMEOUT)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        os.killpg(proc.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
        proc.communicate()
        raise SystemExit(f'{side}: harness killed after {TIMEOUT}s')
    if not out.exists():
        raise SystemExit(f'{side}: harness wrote nothing (exit {proc.returncode})\n{log.decode("utf8", "replace")[-3000:]}')
    return json.loads(out.read_text())


clean_before = git('status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=no') == ''
TARGET.write_text((HERE / 'harness.test.ts').read_text())
try:
    new = run('new')
    git('checkout', BASE, '--', *SUBJECT)
    try:
        old = run('base')
    finally:
        git('checkout', 'HEAD', '--', *SUBJECT)
finally:
    TARGET.unlink()
OUT.write_text(json.dumps({
    'subject': SUBJECT, 'base': BASE, 'fix': git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').strip(),
    'subjectSha256': {f: subprocess.run(['sha256sum', str(ROOT / f)], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.split()[0] for f in SUBJECT},
    'harnessSha256': subprocess.run(['sha256sum', str(HERE / 'harness.test.ts')], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.split()[0],
    'old': old, 'new': new,
    'trackedTreeCleanBefore': clean_before, 'trackedTreeCleanAfter': git('status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=no') == '',
}, indent=2) + '\n')
print('done', len(old), len(new))

"""Builds docs/evidence/adapter-credential-declaration-differential-2026-10-22.json from drive.py's raw output.
Usage: python3 build_differential.py <raw.json> <out.json>"""
import json, sys
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
RAW, OUT = Path(sys.argv[1]), Path(sys.argv[2])
raw = json.loads(RAW.read_text())
REFUSAL = "a configured typed adapter declares a credential the repository's adapter-credential list does not hold: "

old = {row['case']: row for row in raw['old']}
new = {row['case']: row for row in raw['new']}
assert list(old) == list(new), 'the two sides ran different case lists'


def unlisted(row):
    declarations = row['declarations']
    if declarations == 'omitted':
        return []
    configured = row['case'].split(' / configured ')[1].split(' / ')[0] if ' / configured ' in row['case'] else None
    held = {'none': [], 'absent': ['/f/configured-absent.token'], 'readable': ['/f/configured-readable.token']}[configured]
    return [f"{d['adapter']}: {c}" for d in declarations for c in d['credentials'] if c not in held]


def observable(row):
    return {k: row[k] for k in ('result', 'last', 'listReads', 'opens')}


rows, counts = [], {'unchanged': 0, 'stricter': 0, 'refusalReasonChanged': 0, 'moreLenient': 0, 'otherChange': 0}
predicate = {'casesWithNoUnlistedDeclaration': 0, 'ofThoseUnchanged': 0, 'casesWithAnUnlistedDeclaration': 0,
             'ofThoseNewRefusesWithTheDeclarationReasonAloneReadingNothing': 0}
for case in old:
    o, n = old[case], new[case]
    missing = unlisted(n)
    if observable(o) == observable(n):
        kind = 'unchanged'
    elif o['result']['passed'] and not n['result']['passed']:
        kind = 'stricter'
    elif not o['result']['passed'] and not n['result']['passed']:
        kind = 'refusalReasonChanged'
    elif not o['result']['passed'] and n['result']['passed']:
        kind = 'moreLenient'
    else:
        kind = 'otherChange'
    counts[kind] += 1
    if missing:
        predicate['casesWithAnUnlistedDeclaration'] += 1
        expected = {'passed': False, 'why': REFUSAL + ', '.join(missing)}
        if n['result'] == expected and n['last']['outcomes'] == [] and n['listReads'] in (0, None) and n['opens'] in ([], None):
            predicate['ofThoseNewRefusesWithTheDeclarationReasonAloneReadingNothing'] += 1
    else:
        predicate['casesWithNoUnlistedDeclaration'] += 1
        if kind == 'unchanged':
            predicate['ofThoseUnchanged'] += 1
    rows.append({'case': case, 'declarations': n['declarations'], 'unlistedDeclarations': missing, 'classification': kind,
                 'old': observable(o), 'new': observable(n)})

record = {
    'title': 'syzygy-bpyt.8.9 adapter-credential probe: old-versus-new differential over declared and undeclared credentials',
    'bead': 'syzygy-bpyt.8.9',
    'authority': 'OWNER-DIRECTION-GREENFIELD-PARITY-ANSWERS-2026-10-21.md, GP-Q7: "a credential list that fails closed when a configured adapter declares a credential the list lacks"',
    'subject': raw['subject'],
    'subjectSha256': raw['subjectSha256'],
    'base': raw['base'],
    'fix': raw['fix'],
    'command': 'python3 drive.py <worktree> ' + raw['base'] + ' <scratch> <raw.json>; python3 build_differential.py <raw.json> <out.json>',
    'method': ('The harness (harnessSource) runs createCredentialProbe over every fixture case, once with the fix and once with the base '
               'commit\'s subject files written over it (driverSource). The fixture cases cross seven list sources, three repository '
               'lists (CONFIGURED_ADAPTER_CREDENTIALS stand-ins) and seven declaration shapes, one of them the argument omitted as '
               'every CLI call site omits it; the base probe has no fourth parameter and ignores the declarations. An injected open '
               'records every read attempt. Seven more cases use the CLI\'s own call shape, createCredentialProbe(credentialListFromEnv(env)), '
               'with the real operating-system open over real files in a temporary directory (scrubbed to <dir>). A case is unchanged '
               'when result, last(), the number of list reads and the read attempts are all equal.'),
    'trackedTreeCleanBefore': raw['trackedTreeCleanBefore'],
    'trackedTreeCleanAfter': raw['trackedTreeCleanAfter'],
    'summary': {'cases': len(rows), **counts, **predicate},
    'rows': rows,
    'harnessSha256': raw['harnessSha256'],
    'harnessSource': (HERE / 'harness.test.ts').read_text(),
    'driverSource': (HERE / 'drive.py').read_text(),
    'builderSource': Path(__file__).read_text(),
}
OUT.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(record['summary']))
